ITEM 1 | Pale green to yellow-green leafy vegetable pieces, stems and leaves, some with glossy wilted surfaces and darker green edges, arranged in a loose cluster on the upper right of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, lightly cooked and moist, holding shape, no visible sauce | 60

ITEM 2 | Two breaded or crumb-coated pieces, golden-brown to tan with a speckled, grainy crust, one smaller irregular piece about 4 cm by 3 cm and a larger piece about 7 cm by 5 cm with a shiny orange-brown interior edge exposed, lying in the lower center of the plate, appears fried with dry crisp surface and a slightly oily sheen, holds shape | 110
